note: Central Bank of Sudan Act 2002, as published on the bank's own site (cbos.gov.sd/en/node/454), under the heading 'Audit of the Bank's accounts' states only: 'Accounts of the Bank shall be audited, in accordance with the General Audit Chambers Act, 1999', and requires an audited copy of the annual accounts to go to the President of the Republic within three months of year end. It names a statute, not an auditor: no auditing body and no firm is named, so this is a near-miss rather than a record. No CBOS annual-report auditor's report page was located.

Loi n 2016-004 portant statut de la Banque Centrale de Madagascar (assemblee-nationale.mg) was read: Article 76 provides for 'un Cabinet d'audit' / 'auditeur externe' appointed by the Conseil d'administration, Article 73 has the Board appoint the external auditor on the Audit Committee's proposal, and Article 85 says the statements are audited by an external auditor designated under Article 76. No firm or body is named. The Cour des Comptes appears in Articles 34 and 7 only as a recipient of the annual report and as a body against which the Bank's autonomy cannot be invoked, not as auditor. An IMF French staff report search returned no auditor name.

The only Banque du Liban publication reachable by search was its Annual Report 2024 PDF on bdl.gov.lb, which is a balance-of-payments and international-investment-position report and contains no BDL financial statements or auditor's report. Searches for a BDL auditor's report returned only commercial-bank reports, EY Lebanon's transparency report, and press coverage of the Alvarez & Marsal forensic audit, which is a special-purpose forensic engagement, not the statutory audit of BDL's financial statements, and which A&M terminated for lack of information. No source naming BDL's statutory external auditor was readable.

Banque Centrale du Congo. Four French-language searches (annual report, etats financiers audites, commissaire aux comptes, auditeur externe, plus bcc.cd and the big-four firm names) returned only commercial-bank accounts (Rawbank, Equity BCDC, Access Bank, Bank of Africa) and Deloitte's DRC banking-sector studies. IMF country report cr14315f (French) was read and names no BCC external auditor; its only audit-firm reference is an unnamed 'cabinet international' that audited the state insurer SONAS in 2012. A press report that the Cour des comptes announced an audit mission at the central bank does not state who audits its financial statements.

Congo-Brazzaville has no national central bank of its own: it is a member of BEAC, whose auditor could not be read (see the CMR note). No Congo-specific BEAC national directorate audit document was found.
Chad has no national central bank of its own: it is a member of BEAC, whose auditor could not be read (see the CMR note). No Chad-specific BEAC national directorate audit document was found.

Banque de la Republique du Burundi. Two searches (French, for the annual report, etats financiers, commissaire aux comptes and audit externe, including brb.bi and the big-four firm names) returned only Burundian commercial banks (Bancobu, Interbank, BCB, BGF, CRDB) and Wikipedia mirrors. No BRB annual report, financial statements or auditor's report was reachable.

Banque Centrale de Mauritanie. A French search for the annual report, commissaire aux comptes and auditeur externe returned only Mauritanian utility audit terms of reference, PEFA and World Bank ROSC accounting reports. IMF French report cr18356f was read in full: it is an external-sector-statistics technical assistance report that discusses the BCM's balance of payments work and lists officials met, and names no external auditor.

Banco de Cabo Verde. Two Portuguese searches for the relatorio e contas, auditor externo, certificacao legal das contas and the big-four firm names returned only Cabo Verdean commercial banks (Caixa Economica, BCN, BAI, Banco Interatlantico) and press summaries of BCV results. Boletim Oficial bulletin 735 on boe.incv.cv was read: it discusses the BCV only as the monetary authority; its auditing references are to Banco Interatlantico's Conselho Fiscal (individuals, not a firm) and to Deloitte & Associados SROC as fiscal unico of A Promotora, an unrelated venture-capital company. No BCV auditor's report was readable.

Banque d'Algerie. A French search for the annual report, commissaires aux comptes, bilan certifie and audit externe returned only Algerian commercial banks (BNP Paribas El Djazair, Al Baraka, BDL, Bank ABC) and a 2015 AACB symposium paper. The bank-of-algeria.dz annual-reports index page was returned by search but no auditor's report page or financial statements with a signed opinion was located, and no source naming the Banque d'Algerie's commissaires aux comptes was readable.

Central Bank of Libya. Searched for the annual report auditor, for the Audit Bureau/Diwan al-Muhasaba, and for the audit article of Law No. 1 of 2005. cbl.gov.ly/en/?p=9011 was read: it covers the CBL's audits OF commercial banks (citing Article 83 of Law No. 1 of 2005) and says nothing about who audits the CBL itself. The Deloitte engagement widely reported in 2021 was a one-off UN-commissioned special audit of the CBL, not the statutory audit of its financial statements, and no readable page states that it signed an auditor's report on the financial statements. Law No. 79 of 1975 on the Audit Bureau was located but not read and in any case is a general Audit Bureau statute, not a CBL provision naming it as the Bank's auditor.

Palestine Monetary Authority. Two searches for the annual report, financial statements and independent auditor's report returned only PMA press releases, PCBS balance-of-payments releases, centralbanking.com summaries, and regalert.today copies of PMA circulars. regalert.today document e95ea4e9-2d85-4d9e-94a3-db111c766ec1 was read: it is PMA Circular No. (9) 2012 on BANKS' external auditors under Article 47 of Banking Law No. 9 of 2010, and names no firm for the PMA's own accounts. No PMA auditor's report was reachable.

Central Bank of Yemen. A search for its audited financial statements and independent auditor's report returned only Yemeni commercial banks (National Bank of Yemen, International Bank of Yemen), the IFRS Yemen jurisdiction profile, a Crowe Yemen service page and UNOPS audit reports. No CBY financial statements or auditor's report was reachable, and neither the Aden nor the Sanaa administration publishes one that search surfaced.

Banco Central de Venezuela. A Spanish search for the BCV law's external-audit article, the Contraloria General de la Republica and auditores externos returned the BCV's own half-year financial statements and notes PDFs (bcv.org.ve), the Ley Organica de la Administracion Financiera del Sector Publico, and April 2026 press coverage of separate US- and Venezuela-commissioned audit firms engaged to oversee the use of Venezuelan assets abroad - which is not the statutory audit of the BCV's financial statements and names no firm in the readable text. No source naming the BCV's external auditor was readable.

Banque de la Republique d'Haiti. The French search returned three copies of the SAME tender notice on emploi.lenouvelliste.com - 'Audit des etats financiers de la Banque de la Republique d'Haiti (BRH) pour les exercices fiscaux 2025-2026, 2026-2027 et 2027-2028' - which is a call for proposals, not an award, and names no firm. No BRH annual report, financial statements or award notice naming the external auditor was reachable.

Banco Central de Sao Tome e Principe. A Portuguese search for the relatorio e contas and relatorio de auditoria independente returned only BCSTP financial-stability, payment-system and macroeconomic reports (bcstp.st), Sao Tomean parliamentary diaries, an IMF Portuguese staff report, and a 2000s news item about a Portuguese team auditing the central bank that names no firm. A Tribunal de Contas news item notes institutions' failure to file annual reports. No BCSTP auditor's report was reachable.
